watch.summary: The creator insults a pro Valorant player's skill right before the player pulls off an unbelievable kill while completely blinded.

beats.what: Creator mocks the player on screen, calling him 'literally not that guy'.
Creator casually drinks water while watching the round.
The blinded player in the clip somehow shoots and kills an opponent.
Creator stops drinking and shouts in complete disbelief.
Creator gives up defending his stance and mutters 'Yeah, whatever man'.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: How is he blind and gets the pick?
watch.why: The instant shut-down of the creator's trash talk by an improbable play creates classic comedic irony. His shift from confident insult to bewildered defeat makes for an entertaining reaction.
